title: Simple Condensation Table
text: Condense your own mana into Spiritual Crystals without supplying ingredients.

Hold right-click anywhere on the table to channel mana and condense a crystal. Each cycle takes 5 seconds and charges 100 base mana on completion; cost reductions apply. Briefly right-click the central output area to collect crystals.
Releasing right-click, moving away or running short of mana cancels the current cycle. After a mana shortage, release and press again to retry.
